The `@codemirror/legacy-modes/mode/*` rows are small stream-parser modes (a handful of KB each), one file per mode, so Slop Code loads a language only when a file needs it (`code/js/lang-load.js`, with the file names and sniffing rules in `code/js/langs-more.js`). `simple-mode` is not a language: `dockerfile`, `rust` and `wast` import it. Several modes export more than one parser (`clike`: C, C++, Java, C#, Kotlin, Scala, Objective-C, Dart and more; `sql` dialects; `mllike`: OCaml, F# and Standard ML; `xml` and `html`).

## How it was made

`tools/vendor-codemirror.mjs` (build time only, run by hand with `node tools/vendor-codemirror.mjs`) fetches each package's ESM entry from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<package>@<version>/`. It checks that every bare import is one of the pinned packages (a legacy mode may also import another listed mode, see Notes), writes the files above, `LICENSES.txt` (each licence text, grouped), and `import-map.json`. Every file gets one header comment line naming the package, version and source. Nothing else is edited (one exception, for a legacy mode that imports a sibling: see Notes).

The app loads these files from the site itself. `code/index.html` has an inline import map with the same entries as `import-map.json` (`tests/code/vendor.test.html` checks that they match). Nothing is fetched from a CDN at run time.

## Notes

- The files are the packages' unminified ES modules, copied as shipped. Several are longer than 300 lines. That limit applies to the code Slop writes, not to vendored upstream code.
- A legacy mode that imports a sibling (`import {simpleMode} from "./simple-mode.js"`) has that one specifier rewritten to the import-map form (`"@codemirror/legacy-modes/mode/simple-mode"`), so the file resolves from `vendor/codemirror/`. The first line of such a file says so. Nothing else in a mode file is edited.
- The script clears the generated files before writing, but keeps this `README.md`.
- To update, change the versions in the script, run it, then update this table and the import map in `code/index.html`.
